svg.aria-label: ADR-006: the associative memory layer under test in two variants behind a flag; the control identical in everything but the variable; benchmarks frozen before any run; three verdicts with a circuit breaker and a bounded refine and retry; the router of memories on a control floor; several seeds, intervals, anchors, and a retrogradation kept in the record
svg.title: ADR-006 — The ablation protocol: one variable against a sacred control, benchmarks frozen before any run, three verdicts
svg.text: The ablation protocol: one variable against a sacred control, benchmarks frozen before any run, three verdicts
quantum-cortex, original figure for ADR-006. The protocol is fixed before the first run, so that results are read honestly and losses are published.
Decision one: what is under test
an associative memory layer, a third residual sub block
inside every block, behind a flag, default off
variant H, energy based
a learned key value memory read
by attention over stored patterns,
retrieval by energy descent:
the "magnetism" formulation
variant D, gated delta rule
a per head recurrent state with an
error correcting rank one write and
a forget gate: the family's
incumbent, the honest baseline
two variants of one family: the bar is the incumbent, not only a vanilla model
Decisions two and three: the control, the benchmarks

g.text: the control is sacred and equal at everything: every run is
identical to it except the feature under test, same data hash,
same parameter budget, seed, tokens and schedule;
flags off: the model is bit identical to the control, a test asserts it
frozen before any run: associative recall by difficulty tiers;
the serial position curve, primacy and recency, the curve itself
the deliverable; perplexity stays the guard, never the axis;
the continuity triad waits for the persistent tier
no comparison is valid across different data hashes

svg.text: Decisions four and five: the verdict, in the record

g.text: advances
a declared capability win within the perplexity tolerance
held
the control stands; the loss is published, the register notes it
aborted, unstable
the breaker's verdict: a result on the frontier

svg.text: the record's comparison slot carries the control's run id, that the data
hash is shared, the capability deltas, the perplexity delta, the verdict
Decision seven: the circuit breaker, aggressive abort with a bounded refine and retry

g.text: abort criteria, declared first
hard: a non finite loss, at once;
divergence from the control at the same step;
stagnation while the control still improves;
never tuned after the fact
refine and retry, bounded
pre declared refinements, in order:
a tighter gradient clip, then a
lower learning rate; the bound
is mandatory
then death
if the retries fail;
permanent; a recovery
is recorded as such;
every attempt logged

svg.text: conservative on the slow, ruthless on the broken: a slowly converging architecture is not killed
prematurely, a non finite loss is beyond appeal; every attempt records its cause and its step in the ledger;
one primitive at three scales: kill a variable (the protocol), abort a decode on a contract violation
(the veto), evict noise (the memory): cut cleanly what destabilises to preserve the whole
Decisions eight and nine: a router of memories on a control floor; unattackable claims

g.text: paths per span: the control, always available; the energy memory; the delta memory;
a memory is used only where it beats the control, else the control: the layer cannot degrade the model
soft routing where unsure, hard where learned and stable, migrating as it consolidates; the breaker
re routes to the best remaining path above the floor, with a declared hysteresis; one router per block;
a versioned contract fixed before the code: extend, never break
several seeds with intervals and paired tests: a gap is claimed only when significant;
one seed claims nothing; an external anchor of three families at equal size: no memory,
a pure recurrent ladder, the attention control; the learned router's claim retrograded and kept
in the record: proven on a synthetic routing task, open on real spans, caught before publication

svg.text: Decision six: the order, measure first, one variable at a time, each slice tested before the next
the layers in the model with a bit identity test and a forward shape test, no run; the benchmarks as evaluation only;
then the runs, every variant against the control; the advancement rule and the tolerances are frozen before numbers exist: nothing is claimed until the runs exist

g.text: what is under test
the rules fixed before any run
what advances; the router on its floor, the anchors, the claims' discipline
what is cut and published as such
